title: Parts only includes only P invoices, Service only includes only S invoices, and Parts & Service applies no filter
refs: specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 3 S3-R4; S3-R5; S3-R6; S3-R7
custom_preconds: 1. A rep has both a P (parts) and an S (service) invoice in the range (seed ZZAUTOTEST data via the WO Sales Rep field).
custom_steps:
1. Select "Parts only," expand the rep, and read the invoice numbers.
2. Select "Service only" and read them again.
3. Select "Parts & Service."
custom_expected:
1. "Parts only" includes only invoices whose number starts with P.
2. "Service only" includes only invoices whose number starts with S.
3. "Parts & Service" applies no product-type filter — both appear again.
4. Each change re-fetches and re-renders the report.
